name: Casebook
description: Fill a patient casebook form from an audio recording or a text conversation.

input.note: If audio is given it is transcribed by STT first; if text is given, STT is skipped.

steps.name: fill_casebook
steps.system_prompt: You are a clinical intake assistant. From the conversation, fill the patient casebook form. Only fill a field if the conversation clearly states it; if a value is not mentioned, leave it null. Never guess or invent patient information. Respond with JSON only, matching the template.
